text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. To address safety concerns and congestion in the area of Chaminade College School (490 Queen's Drive), it is recommended that a school bus loading zone be created to accommodate school buses. The change will facilitate the loading/unloading of buses transporting students to/from Chaminade College School. This recommendation is the result of consultation with the area Councillor and the school's principal.
